name: ThirdShotHub Tacky Overgrip 3-Pack
description: The ThirdShotHub Tacky Overgrip 3-Pack is a high-tack polyurethane overgrip for players who sweat through a cushioned grip inside one session. At 0.6 mm it adds roughly a quarter grip size when wrapped with a standard half-overlap, so a 4.125 in handle wrapped with one of these plays close to a 4.25 in. Each pack contains three grips and three finishing tapes.

specifications.material: Perforated polyurethane over a woven backing
specifications.size_effect: Adds approximately 1/4 grip size at half-overlap

care_instructions: Replace an overgrip once it stops returning to tack after drying — a slick grip is the leading cause of paddle-throwing injuries at the kitchen line. Do not wash and reuse; the polyurethane layer separates from its backing once wet through. Unwrap and discard the old grip before wrapping a new one rather than stacking, which inflates the handle past its stated size.
